meta.scope: Chile batch 2 — Short-term industrial & commerce indicators, external sector (BOP / trade), monetary aggregates, and IMACEC activity. Builds on Batch 1 core.

candidates.title: Índice de Producción Minera (IPMin)
candidates.description: Monthly volume index of mining production (metallic, non-metallic, energy resources). Component of the broader IPI. Critical for a mining-intensive economy.
candidates.notes: Flagship mining volume indicator. June 2026: +6.0% year-on-year. Lithium carbonate and metallic mining frequently drive the swings. Direct input into national accounts and external-sector analysis.

candidates.title: Índice de Producción Manufacturera (IPMan)
candidates.description: Monthly volume index of manufacturing production. Component of the IPI.
candidates.notes: Manufacturing counterpart to the mining index. June 2026: −3.2% year-on-year in one recent release window. Food processing and other divisions regularly detailed.

candidates.title: Índice de Producción de Electricidad, Gas y Agua (IPEGA)
candidates.description: Monthly volume index of electricity, gas and water production/distribution. Component of the IPI.
candidates.notes: Utilities component of industrial production. Completes the three-pillar IPI structure (mining, manufacturing, EGA).

candidates.title: Índice de Actividad del Comercio (IAC)
candidates.description: Monthly index of commercial activity (wholesale, retail, automotive). Published at constant prices with electronic-commerce and supermarket sub-indices.
candidates.notes: Principal short-term commerce indicator. Recent releases have shown solid retail and automotive contributions; electronic-commerce sub-index frequently grows double-digit.

candidates.title: IMACEC — Indicador Mensual de Actividad Económica
candidates.description: Monthly estimator of economic activity compiled by the Central Bank. Primary high-frequency GDP proxy, drawing on INE volume indicators and other sources.
candidates.notes: Chilean counterpart to Argentina’s EMAE. Central Bank product that integrates the INE industrial, commerce and other monthly series into a single activity measure.

candidates.title: Balanza de Pagos y Posición de Inversión Internacional
candidates.description: Quarterly balance of payments and international investment position. Covers current account, capital/financial account, and the stock of external assets and liabilities.
candidates.notes: Core external-accounts product. Q1 2026: current-account surplus of USD 1.9 bn (1.9% of GDP). Annual yearbook and detailed quarterly releases available.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
candidates.publisher: Banco Central de Chile / Aduanas (with INE support)
candidates.description: Monthly and quarterly statistics of exports and imports of goods, including copper and other mining products, by partner and by product.
candidates.notes: Trade data feed both the balance of payments and the national accounts. Copper remains the dominant single export; lithium and other non-metallic minerals are rising.

candidates.title: Base monetaria y agregados monetarios
candidates.description: Regular statistics of the monetary base and broader monetary aggregates (M1, M2, etc.) published by the Central Bank.
candidates.notes: Core monetary statistics. Published in the Central Bank’s statistical bulletins and database with clear definitions of the aggregates.

candidates.title: Índices Nominales de Remuneraciones y de Costos Laborales
candidates.description: Monthly indices of nominal wages and labour costs. Complement the ENE employment statistics with a price-of-labour measure.
candidates.notes: Wage and labour-cost counterpart to the employment survey. June 2026: nominal remunerations +7.7% year-on-year; labour costs +8.4%.

candidates.title: Encuesta de Caracterización Socioeconómica Nacional (CASEN)
candidates.publisher: Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia (with INE methodological support)
candidates.description: Periodic multi-purpose household survey that is the primary source for multidimensional and income poverty estimates, living conditions, and social-programme targeting.
candidates.notes: Key social survey. Complements the income-poverty methodology that uses EPF and IPC. Provides the broader living-conditions picture used in policy evaluation.

proposed_edges.basis: IPMin is one of the three component indices of the IPI.
IPMan is the manufacturing component of the IPI.
IPEGA is the electricity/gas/water component of the IPI.
IMACEC is compiled and published by the Banco Central de Chile.
Balance of payments and IIP are Central Bank products.
Merchandise trade flows are a primary input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
Wage indices complement the employment and hours data from the ENE.
CASEN supplies the household income and living-conditions data used in poverty and social characterisation.
